nodes.description: address public owner; current owner of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
address public newOwner; pending owner used by the two-step transferOwnership/acceptOwnership flow.
string public symbol; token symbol 'BBCC' written in the BigBlockCoin constructor.
string public name; token name written in the BigBlockCoin constructor.
uint8 public decimals; set to 18 in the constructor.
uint public _totalSupply; total minted supply credited to the deployer-specified address.
mapping(address=>uint) balances; per-account token balances mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowances written by approve/approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure; performs c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure; performs c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure; performs c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure; performs c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned() constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner; stages newOwner for two-step ownership transfer.
acceptOwnership(); requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and finalises owner.
BigBlockCoin() constructor; sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and credits the whole supply to a hard-coded address.
totalSupply() constant; returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant; returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens); debits msg.sender via safeSub and credits 'to' via safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens); overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend protection.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens); debits balances[from], decreases allowance and credits 'to'.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant; returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data); writes allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval (external, state-changing callback).
Fallback function () public payable; unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner; externally calls ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller address used for identity, authorization and balance indexing.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) made while allowance state has just been written; reentrancy vector.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, attacker-influenced token address; reentrancy vector and trust boundary.
Raw arithmetic c = a + b in safeAdd; overflow-prone primitive guarded afterwards by require(c >= a).
Raw arithmetic c = a - b in safeSub; underflow-prone primitive guarded afterwards by require(b <= a).
Raw arithmetic c = a * b in safeMul; overflow-prone primitive guarded afterwards by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).

safeAdd performs unchecked raw addition c = a + b before the require guard.
safeSub performs unchecked raw subtraction c = a - b before the require guard.

The invoked token contract can call back into transferAnyERC20Token or other functions during the external transfer.
